== English Virtual Original comparison ==
The early text allows the player to take either end of the Force Pile once per control phase for 1 Force, with a free action if Dutch is aboard. Only the power and immunity bonuses required Dutch to pilot. The 2006 text applies the Dutch-piloting condition to the entire ability and omits the Force cost. The passenger capacity, power modifier and immunity threshold are unchanged. The 2003 and 2004 supplements clarify that the choice is made without looking at either card.
